integration_method: Production-only three-way deltas, with exact source record composition for overlapping move tables. Original PR branches, main, recovery snapshot, existing tests, workflows and formal accounting preserved. This is not a main acceptance merge.
conflict_resolutions: Keep accepted main Batch A data, definitions and descriptions for Seed Bomb, Petal Blizzard, Aura Sphere and the other existing entries.
Replace only inert numeric placeholders for integrated move IDs; preserve existing IDs. Use dedicated Thunder Fang effect from PR 181 rather than conflicting alternate dispatch from PR 183.
Retain main spread replay guard and extend it to Discharge/Petal Blizzard using the same shared all-other-recipient controller; avoid replay by both controllers.
Remove duplicate Seed Bomb/Petal Blizzard/Aura Sphere description declarations reported by first compilation, retaining existing main text.
known_incomplete: Follower external artwork is not bundled or fetched: registry has zero entries, so this build does not provide visible following sprites.
Move IDs 402, 404 and 405 remain unimplemented/inert; no new move mechanics or distributions invented.
No full natural story, boot, save compatibility, hardware or link behavior has been tested on this integration.
